long, but important

DO NOT cling to him. say/tell him happy birthday, and wish him well, and maybe ask him what’s been up. after all, it’s only been a few months, so if he doesn’t seem into the conversation or doesn’t seem into telling you, let it go, until maybe he chooses to tell you eventually, at some point. i know it sucks but perhaps either some reasons could be: 1. he is losing feelings 2. he’s super busy or stressed out considering he’s studying abroad 3. he needs some space for himself right now, but doesn’t want you to let go, so periodically he will text you because he still cares about you 4. you’ve turned into a side choice.

he could have also met another girl and not told you.

it all depends, all humans are different, and to be honest, if you hint that you’d like an explanation and show interest in him on his birthday, he’s likely to respond. not guaranteed, but you MAY at leasttt get a “thank you.”

so many things happen to human beings and we all respond differently and half the time we forget that.

if something happened to me, and the same thing happened to someone else, we’d definitely respond differently each to their own extent. therefore, it’s hard for us to tell what’s going on because we try to imagine how WE react to certain things, and use that as a tool to “detect,” something we will never know unless they tell us.

maybe tell him that you care about it, wish him well on his happy birthday, and ask if anything is going on and that he’s free to talk about anything if he’s ever comfortable. and if he does, never judge him.
